subject: general
question: The Sarnath Lion Capital erected by the Mauryan Ruler Ashoka, was made up of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandstone.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lion Capital is situated at Sarnath****, **close by Varanasi.
 
• It was constructed in 250 BCE.
 
• It is made up of polished sandstone. 
 
• The Lion Capital of Ashoka is the capital of a column dig out by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) in Sarnath, Uttar Pradesh, India exhibiting four Asiatic lions standing back to back on a round abacus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under each lion, the abacus shows a dharma chakra, the Buddhist wheel of the moral law in high relief. In the **middle of the chakras, the figure of a lion, an elephant, a bull, and a horse, appear also in high relief. **
 
• The revealing of the model was undertaken by F. O. Oertel in the ASI winter season of 1904–1905.​
 
• In July 1947, Jawaharlal Nehru, the interim prime minister of India, and soon-to-be prime minister of the Dominion of India formally proposed in the Constituent Assembly of India that the wheel on the abacus of the Sarnath capital be the model of the national flag of India and the capital itself without the lotus the state emblem of India.
 
• **The proposal was accepted in December 1947****.**
